GREG, 2026-11-07 about 16:54Z, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e #615, message 26f64e32). Verbatim: „Bardzo prosze sie upewnic aby tak sie nie dzialo”. It answered whether the execution_observe message / full source_id is loaded into an agent's context.
Requirement (Asistant's scope): the complete execution_observe payload and a complete source_id must NOT be put AUTOMATICALLY into an agent's context: prompts, tool output, hooks, notifications, transcripts or compaction. Short summaries stay allowed. An explicit agent command (e.g. `engram source`, `show --observations`) is a separate case. Ensure it in the current content-v1 cleanup on both sides (Engram w-d9dbcd311958, TermAl w-6f42c416b0c7) and check existing paths in review. No new heavy gates and no tautological tests.
State at 16:55Z, verified from code: TermAl sends it host→Engram only (worker engram_unadmitted_worker.rs:192–293; reports kept in internal state, engram_host_adapter.rs:2003–2006). Engram returns ids+uncredited only. next, the work-context hook and feeds carry no observations. Explicit `show --observations` renders only SourceIdSummary "source_id commit X; tree Y; N changes; M submodules" (src/source.rs:49–63 in candidate 1b5394bb). Open gap: TermAl host stderr not exhaustively audited for payload dumps.
How it's checked: an acceptance criterion on both cleanup items, and an explicit item in both reviewers' briefs for every change touching observation, display or host-adapter paths. Behavior tests only where they already exist (bounded display).
